notice.title: About this content.
notice.shows: graph.med shows the structure of published clinical practice guidelines: their recommendations, grades and the patient groups they address.
notice.ai: The content was extracted from the source documents with the help of AI, and parts of it were generated by AI: the recommendation wordings, the concepts, their links and the groupings. The content has not been clinically reviewed.
